_comment: When the CURRENT Sign in with Apple web secret expires. Apple caps the JWT at six months and says nothing when it lapses; scripts/health.py warns a fortnight ahead, which is rung 2. The secret itself is NOT here and must never be: regenerate it with scripts/apple_secret.py on a machine holding the .p8, paste it into Supabase, and write the new date below. The iOS app does not use this and is never affected.
